policy: Every Compatibility Layer / Transitional Layer in the codebase must have a real Exit Strategy recorded here before it ships (owner, 2026-08-05) — no iframe embed, shim, or bridge is allowed to exist without one. removal_condition_met stays false until the owner has actually verified the Removal Condition true (Runtime + Registry + End-to-End all real-checked, never inferred) — scripts/check-transitional-layers.ts only proposes removal for entries where this is already true; it never flips it itself. Different from registry/capability-roadmap.json (feature progress) — this is specifically the removal contract for temporary bridges.

layers.temporary_reason: Corrected 2026-08-05 — this page was rebuilt as a UI-structure-only skeleton (owner directive, "โครงหน้าห้องผลิตโค้ด" pass): no iframe, no external embedded IDE. It renders entirely from mock fixture data (components/ide-shell/mockData.ts). AI, GitHub, Supabase, a real Terminal backend, and Deploy are explicitly not connected this round (scope limit set by the owner, not a blocked dependency).
layers.replacement_target: Real backend wiring per panel, named generically (AI Provider / Source Control Provider / Runtime Provider / Database Provider) — no specific vendor or route committed yet. Each panel currently reading components/ide-shell/mockData.ts needs its own real data source before it stops being mock.
layers.removal_condition: Every panel currently showing mock data or "Not connected" reads/writes through a real, named backend, and components/ide-shell/mockData.ts is no longer imported by IDEWorkspace.tsx.
layers.blocking_dependency: No real backend wiring exists yet for the Source Control, AI, Runtime, or Database panels on this page — none built as of this entry.
